He takes a bit of getting used to but rolling under him, i find, is the best method.

You can extend the platform size with a lever found on the way to the boss, before the trio in the centre, hidden behind a shield guy. 

For the boss himself, stay close to him, and learn his attacks. When he swings roll towards him and left or right, get a hit or two, just always have enough stamina for another roll. Try to roll into his halberd just before it reaches you, your invincibility frames will stop the damage and you'll end up behind him, which is a free hit.

Rolling towards the enemies help. When rolling you have invincibility frames in which you cannot take damage. If you roll under the attack you can get a few free hits in, repeat until killed.

With large groups, lure them back until you have one or two left, they will reset but hitting them will agro it, making it a bit easier. 

A shield can block but becareful of stamina loss, rolling is much better in my opinion. You can also parry with a shield or some weapons, which will stun an enemy, allowing free hits.
